mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_tb( room_id, mentor_id, mentee_id, review_title, review_content, review_code_path, review_language, review_reg_date ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{mentorId}, #{menteeId}, #{reviewTitle}, #{reviewContent}, NULL, #{reviewLanguage}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, room_id AS roomId, mentor_id AS mentorId, mentee_id AS menteeId, review_title AS reviewTitle, review_content AS reviewContent, review_code_path AS reviewCodePath, review_language AS reviewLanguage, review_reg_date AS reviewRegDate FROM review_tb WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
